items.title: Peter Vacher interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 18, 2001
items.q: And in London you had Sinclair Traill who founded Jazz Journal, you had Max Jones, you had Charles Fox, you had Albert McCarthy. These are major people in terms of documenting the music.

ctx.x: We were very fortunate. There was a number of writers who I think in a way, this is a difficult claim, seemed to take the music more seriously than their American counterparts. You know you have people like Panassié in France and Charles Delaunay. And in London you had Sinclair Traill who founded Jazz Journal, you had Max Jones, you had Charles Fox, you had Albert McCarthy. These are major people in terms of documenting the music. Albert McCarthy along with Charles Delaunay were the first discographers. There…
Is there an exotic factor to something, an art form that comes from another country?
